newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Nov vehicle sales fall 3.7 pct yr/yr - Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai Nov vehicle sales fall 3.7 pct yr/yr - Toyota.

text.p: Sales of cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand declined 3.7 percent in November to 48,105 units from 49,947 in the same month last year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Tuesday.
Cumulative vehicle sales in the first 11 months rose 4.3 percent to 530,986 units from 508,857 in the same period last year, Toyota said in a statement.
Toyota remained the top seller of vehicles in the month with a 31.2 percent market share on sale of 15,007 units, up from 13,850 in the same month a year ago, it said.
Isuzu was second with 10,266 sold in November, representing 21.3 percent market share, compared with 11,085 in the month a year ago, Toyota said.
Toyota passenger-car sales in the month rose 30.4 percent to 3,934 from 3,018 a year earlier. It was the top passenger-car seller with 27.6 percent share in the month.
Honda came in second with 3,222 cars sold in the month, or 22.6 percent of the market, compared with 2,379 in the same month the previous year, it said.
